title: Your Worst Nightmare
description:
S05 E02 — Play Dead
After 30-year-old single mother Kaye Robinson turns a stranger away from her door late at night, she has no idea that the threat to her family is far from over; with her young son in the home, Kaye will do everything in her power to keep him safe.

title: Evil Lives Here
description:
S18 E01 — I Know Who the Real Monster Is
When Ryan's mother marries Blaine Nelson, he hopes he'll gain a fun-loving stepdad; instead, he gets chaos, pain and fear, and while Blaine relishes tormenting Ryan, he can never imagine just how dark and sadistic his stepfather truly is.

title: Evil Lives Here
description:
S04 E01 — I Invited Him In
Jill Garrison thinks her second chance at love will last forever; when her town is best by a killer, she fails to realize she has invited him into her home.

title: Evil Lives Here
description:
S03 E08 — The Cop and the Killer
When Walt Chavis joins the police force, he is prepared to risk his life, but he never imagines the greatest threat will come in the form of his own brother or that he will be forced to choose between his duty and his family.

title: The 1980s: The Deadliest Decade
description:
S01 E01 — The Yuppie Murder
In Boston, Carol Stuart and her unborn child are shot dead, while her husband, Charles, survives the shooting to describe their black assailant and inflame racial tensions, then a witness comes forward with a story that blows open the case.

title: The 1980s: The Deadliest Decade
description:
S01 E02 — The Preppy Murder
Teenager Jennifer Levin is found strangled to death in Central Park, and a prep school heartthrob, Robert Chambers, is arrested for the crime; the press seizes on Chambers' claim that Levin's death happened during rough sex.

title: The 1980s: The Deadliest Decade
description:
S01 E04 — The Heartland Massacre
An entire family is wiped out in a mass murder, stunning a small town in Missouri; at first, the unlikely suspect is a 14-year-old boy, but the truth turns out to be even more shocking.

title: People Magazine Investigates
description:
S03 E13 — The Sound of Silence
Gallaudet University is the premier college for the deaf in the United States, but this haven of higher learning is turned upside down after two students are murdered in their dormitory rooms.

title: People Magazine Investigates
description:
S03 E09 — Murder on Newberry St.
In York, Pa., race riots claim the lives of an African-American mother and a young, white police officer; their deaths are largely forgotten until 30 years later when their cold cases are reopened, revealing the city's dark past.

title: People Magazine Investigates
description:
S03 E08 — Fatal Family Secrets
A celebratory night turns deadly for the Whitaker family as they are gunned down at home; when investigators uncover a conspiracy, it will test one man's ability to forgive as he fights to save the criminal mastermind from the death penalty.

title: People Magazine Investigates
description:
S03 E06 — Murder Among Friends
In the summer of 1980, a popular teen goes for a run around her hometown in Maine and, days later, her savagely beaten body is found; what happened remains a mystery for years until her mother intervenes and forces police to re-examine the case.

title: Betrayed
description:
S04 E07 — Unholy Alliances
Church secretary Dorothy "Dot" Finelli, 59, goes missing and turns up dead; police explore if she has been killed by a jealous new internet date or somebody she's known for years within her own family circle.

title: Betrayed
description:
S04 E09 — The Predator of Pleasant View
Suzy Goulart, 23, is just getting by like everybody else in the scrappy Pleasant View apartment complex, where little dramas between friends and lovers add up to Suzy's murder.

title: Betrayed
description:
S04 E02 — Killing With Kindness
Kind-hearted cashier Elizabeth Grosskopf scoops up human strays like puppies until one who wants more than just food and shelter kills her.

title: Obsession: Dark Desires
description:
S05 E06 — Can't Let Go
Eighteen-year-old Misty's parents warn her against becoming involved with a man who is nearly 15 years her senior, but no one realizes that Misty is actually in horrible danger.

title: Obsession: Dark Desires
description:
S05 E03 — Friend Request
When single mother Rosita accepts a stranger's friend request, she has no idea he's hiding a terrifying secret that will lead to a deadly game of cat and mouse.

title: Obsession: Dark Desires
description:
S05 E04 — Cabin in the Woods
Sandra never expected such extreme reprisals from her onetime partner, Norman, but when her daughter gets caught in the crosshairs, no one can predict how far Norman will go.

title: Obsession: Dark Desires
description:
S05 E02 — The Stalker's Imagination
After Katerina leaves her husband, and he fights back in imaginative ways to cause her pain, including getting her locked up for a crime she didn't commit, Katerina must do the unthinkable if she wants to escape forever.

title: Fatal Vows
description:
S07 E04 — Hell on Wheels
Charlene attracts more than one man with her beauty and one by one they all go crazy vying for her love; love may be heavenly, but for some it can be hell.

title: Married to Evil
description:
S01 E03 — The Devil of Denver
When Stacy Malman and Robert Feldman fall in love, it's a dream come true; behind closed doors, life becomes a living hell; one night, a knock at the door forces the couple to confront the truth and triggers a series of events ending in horror.

title: Married to Evil
description:
S03 E02 — The Unusual Suspect
Jeanne and Stephen Trantel have the dream life. But when Stephen loses his job after 9/11, their relationship splinters, and Jeanne suspects he is hiding a terrible secret - until an unexpected call reveals the shocking truth.

title: Fear Thy Neighbor
description:
S06 E04 — Deadly Turn
A couple escapes the dangers of the big city and moves to the country; however, they begin to suspect their new neighbors are involved in the drug trade, leading to a bloody conflict with children caught in the crossfire.

A Christian couple open up their home to a young woman who needs help; however, their act of charity has unexpected consequences when emotional support gives way to physical attraction, and a lustful affair turns deadly.

description:
S01 E01 — Night on the Parkway
Billy Carter raises daughters Crystal and Misty in the Great Smoky Mountains of North Carolina; after a body is found on the scenic Blue Ridge Parkway, this family's piece of paradise becomes a nightmare they relive again and again.

title: The Night That Didn't End
description:
S01 E03 — Murder on the Reservation
On the Northern Cheyenne Indian Reservation, a young mother goes missing after the Fourth of July; when her body is discovered in the woods, the victim's family dig through the memories of their loved one to provide investigators with critical clues.

title: The Night That Didn't End
description:
S01 E05 — Murder in the Wetlands
In the coastal town of Leland, N.C., a missing woman is found dead in a swamp; as detectives speak with the victim's friends and family, they begin to unravel the truth behind a horrifying murder.

title: Dead Silent
description:
S03 E02 — Out in the Sticks
After Heather Young and her boyfriend relocate to Michigan's tranquil Lower Peninsula, a nasty fight leads to an explosive and terrifying outcome.

title: Dead Silent
description:

title: Dead Silent
description:

Young love leads 15-year-old Jessica Keen down an increasingly rebellious path that culminates in a night of grave and unfathomable terror in rural Madison County, Ohio.

description:

Host Donnie Wahlberg sheds light on serial killer Larry Hall, from his relationship with his identical twin brother to his murderous rampage against young women across the American heartland in the 1990s.

description:

title: Your Worst Nightmare
description:
S05 E09 — A Way Out
As investigators dive into the missing persons case of 13-year-old Jessyca Mullenberg, they soon realize the meticulous planning that went into her kidnapping and the lengths her abductor is willing to go to avoid being caught.

title: Your Worst Nightmare
description:
S05 E01 — Locked Away
After college graduate Anita Wooldridge goes missing from her parents' home, investigators must rely on quick thinking and cunning police work, as they race against the clock to find her before it's too late.

title: Your Worst Nightmare
description:

Twenty-year-old Kristy Ray is living at home and attending college, then she is abducted; local police seek out the help of the FBI and community members as they race to find Kristy before time runs out.

description:

Trina always had a tough childhood, but it becomes a nightmare when her mother brings home her new boyfriend, Robert; he is not only controlling, but also cruel and violent, and years later she discovers he is a killer.

description:

A home health care nurse falls in love with her married, wheelchair-bound patient but once the secret gets out, someone has to die.

In the wake of a broken marriage, 28-year-old Samantha Lezark's efforts to find love again leads to a fatal ending; now, investigators must follow her digital trail through different chat rooms to uncover her killer.

title: Grave Mysteries
description:
S01 E05 — Killer Chemistry
Professor Tiffany Maher is a faculty favorite, and it's hard to believe she could have any enemies; then, the professor is murdered, leading investigators to discover her secret online life.

title: Grave Mysteries
description:
S01 E02 — Mister Wrong
Ty Underwood leaves her insular hometown to start afresh, vowing to be forthright with potential suitors about being transgender; her shocking murder exposes chats with anonymous men on a phone app.

title: Primal Instinct
description:
S01 E06 — Frozen Heart
Retired Alaska Commissioner of Public Safety Glenn Godfrey must use his years of law enforcement experience to protect his family from an evil force unleashed by his ill-advised romance.

title: Primal Instinct
description:
S01 E02 — Strings Attached
Sparks fly when Chuck Rock meets Beth Williams in Tampa, Fla.; after the relationship turns sour, Chuck finds himself drawn into a puzzling web of intrigue and danger while becoming the target of a mysterious stranger.

title: Primal Instinct
description:
S01 E04 — Catfish Killer
Jenelle Potter develops an attraction that isn't reciprocated, making her feel ostracized and threatened; then, a shadowy figure emerges to entangle her family members in a dark plot with a twisted ending no one saw coming.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S04 E09 — The Women on His List
An unhinged man snaps, unleashing a furious rampage that would leave three women dead in their homes; a statewide manhunt ensues, which yields a misogynistic psychopath hell-bent on revenge.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S02 E01 — I Didn't Do Anything
A former escort hires a hit man to kill her husband; she thinks she's committed the perfect crime when officers notify her that he is dead; little does she know that the police have been watching and recording her every move.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S03 E02 — The Good Girl
A young woman makes a frantic 911 call about a brutal home invasion, which results in the shooting of her mother and father; as police interview her, they uncover a secret double life and an elaborate web of lies spun by a maniacal psychopath.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S03 E05 — You Met the Angel of Death
When a graduate student suddenly goes missing, the family he's staying with immediately contacts police; days later, a horrific discovery forces investigators to face a rare kind of monster.

title: American Monster
description:
S10 E09 — Say Daddy's the Best
Heavily pregnant Colorado native Shanna Vandewege supports her husband Craig's plan to move to Texas for work; the birth of a baby makes up for Shanna's separation from family, but someone is about to exploit her isolation as an outlet for rage.

title: American Monster
description:
S09 E07 — The Whole Building Is Full of Snakes!
Ben Renick is building an empire as a world-renowned breeder of exotic snakes; he has fame, fortune and a young family to share it with, but little does he know, someone he loves is hatching a venomous plot.

title: American Monster
description:
S09 E01 — Rescue Me
John Eichner, his wife and kids look like a happy family in Genoa, Ohio, but behind closed doors a disturbing pattern of torment and gaslighting plays out for years, and well-crafted lies drown out a victim's pleas for help.

title: American Monster
description:
S09 E04 — Brothers and Sisters
Cindy Monkman turns heads wherever she goes, but by age 30, she's looking for something serious; Michael Apelt, a handsome German businessman, seems to be the answer to her prayers, until their first Christmas together turns into a horror story.

title: American Monster
description:

For years, Bill, Stephanie, and their three kids hide their torment while struggling to keep up appearances; the façade shatters for good when someone starts swinging a pickaxe.

description:

Young parents Gary and Tasha Bentley are living the good life; they've got high-paying jobs, a nice house and regular vacations to the tropics, but just five years into their marriage, someone's plotting an exit strategy that ends with a bullet.

title: American Monster
description:

Ashley's new confidence enrages estranged husband Terry, who stalks her to a secluded lot, ready to reclaim control in the deadliest way.

Forty-two-year-old single father of four Richard Mannion is found shot to death in his home, and police suspect he may have been looking for love in all the wrong places.

Forty-three-year old Diane Holik is selling her home to start a new life with her fiancé in Houston, then she misses a meeting at work and police are sent to her home, where they find her bruised and lifeless body.

title: The Killer Beside Me
description:
S01 E03 — The Evil Inside
Kerri Harris and her friend discover a camera secreted in the restroom at work; while police examine the evidence, Harris is stabbed to death in her office with her co-workers just a few feet away.

title: The Killer Beside Me
description:
S01 E05 — Never Predicted
When Andrea Farrington meets fellow employee Alex Kozak, she feels that romance could be on the horizon, then Farrington's hopeful feelings are replaced by suspicion and fear, leading to a final rejection that has fatal consequences.

title: The Killer Beside Me
description:
S01 E04 — Evil Blossoms
Alisha Bromfield's supervisor, Brian Cooper, promotes her to team leader, but his motives are not entirely pure; Bromfield stands her ground, letting Cooper know she doesn't want a relationship beyond a professional one.

title: Suspicious Minds
description:
S01 E06 — Whispers From the Woods
A Pennsylvania town is filled with suspicion after 19-year-old Erica Miller disappears without warning; her mother posts flyers around town, prompting one resident to question the unusual behavior of a family friend.

title: Suspicious Minds
description:
S01 E04 — Rumors in the Halls
Suspicion lands close to home when prom queen Aquilla Flood is found dead in her bedroom; while Aquilla's friends point detectives to three local teens, her own family endures intense questioning about the night this popular young woman died.

title: Suspicious Minds
description:
S01 E03 — Who Killed the Councilman?
Matt Garcia, a city councilman in California, is shot dead; drug dealers, political rivals, and even Matt's own father are all suspects.

title: Disappeared
description:
S10 E04 — The Long Drive Home
Jason Landry disappears while driving home for the holiday break; PI and retired FBI agent Abel Peña does his own investigation and suspects Jason may have been the victim of foul play.

title: Disappeared
description:
S10 E08 — New Mom Missing
On February 24th, 2021, Ciera Breland, a successful lawyer and new mom, disappears after she and her husband, Xavier, visit his mother in Georgia; as Ciera's family and investigators try to find her, they realize her perfect life isn't what it seems.

title: Disappeared
description:
S10 E06 — A Vanishing on the Border
A rumor swirls around the border town of Brownsville, Texas, that Kimberly Avila may have been kidnapped or murdered by a member of the cartel when she went missing on May 13, 2017.
